newsitem.title: UK: Compass prices 220 mln stg convertible bond.
newsitem.headline: Compass prices 220 mln stg convertible bond.

text.p: Compass Group Plc has priced a 220 million stg convertible bond due October 5, 2007, NatWest Markets said on Tuesday.
HSBC is joint lead manager of the transaction.
The deal has a semi-annual coupon of 5.75 percent.
There is a conversion price of 830 stg representing a conversion premium of 21.7 percent over the mid-market price of 682 stg at 1500 BST today.
The issue price is par and fees total 2.5 percent and the pay date is July 29, 1997. There is a short first coupon on October 5, 1997.

The bonds are listed in London and negative pledge and cross default apply. The bonds will be available in global bearer form in denominations of 5,000 stg and 50,000 stg and 5,000 stg in registered form.
There are 602.41 shares per 5,000 stg bond.
There is no call until October 28, 2002.
